authentication: browser session + captcha for the query UI; no account API
cost_notes: Free UI; no lawful automated access found.
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: stats.customs.gov.cn returned HTTP 412 with an anti-automation JS interstitial for every request (also for /queryData); www.customs.gov.cn returned 412 to our client as well on repeat.
There is no documented API and no anonymous bulk download; the only interface is a captcha-driven form.

Chinese customs does not publish company-level bill-of-lading data at all; vendor 'China export' company data comes from separate commercial sources, so China cannot be covered by an open firm-level channel.

Country-level HS-code AGGREGATE statistics only: no company, no shipment, no product identity. Must not be substituted for bill-of-lading (company-level) data, and cannot be used to infer any of the five firms' supply chain.
licence: UNKNOWN (Chinese government site terms; no explicit reuse licence found)
research_value: Would provide China's own HS-code import/export aggregates - a useful mirror for device flows in and out of China. Not accessible without a captcha session; aggregate only in any case.
source_name: China Customs statistics (海关统计数据在线查询平台)
